title: 5 Samsung One UI features you won't get with other Android phones

claims.claim: Samsung's Galaxy smartphones are the world's most popular Android smartphones.

evidence.quote: Samsung's Galaxy smartphones are the world's most popular Android smartphones

claims.claim: One UI 9 is Samsung's most recent version of its skin built on Android 17.

Some of Samsung's exclusive features in One UI 9, the most recent version of its skin built on Android 17, can help you use your devices together more easily.

claims.claim: Good Lock is a container for downloadable plugins, featuring 23 plugins at the time of writing.

evidence.quote: instead of being a single app, Good Lock is a container for downloadable plugins — 23 at the time of writing — that each enable a bundle of settings.

claims.claim: Music Share will disconnect a device if no audio is played from it for 10 minutes by default.

claims.claim: Samsung owns audio brands like Harmon Kardon, Denon, and JBL.

claims.claim: Multi Control works with any PC as of the article's writing.
